title: 80V 24″ Cordless Battery Two-Stage Snow Blower w/ Two (2) 5.0 Ah Batteries &amp; Dual-Port Rapid Charger
description:
Explore More Feature Highlights
Easily adjust the auger to control how far the snow is thrown for maximum control.
A robust handle-mounted chute-adjustment lever puts the user in control when re-directing the snow up to 200° from side to side..
Bright LED lights make it convenient for use early in the morning or at night and the robust steel chassis is built for aggressive use in demanding conditions.
Tri-port powerhead holds up to 3 batteries for the industry’s longest runtime.
Removable battery powers over 75 Greenworks 80-Volt tools.
